prose: Fish Audio has released upgraded weights for Drama 3, its voice model, and Artificial Analysis' independent benchmarks put it at the top of the open-weight field. On the Speech Arena leaderboards, Drama 3 takes the #1 open-weight spot on both Provider Voice (where it ranks #6 overall, +38 Elo over the Preview) and Controlled Voice (+22 Elo over Preview), and it is #1 of all models on the Pronunciation Robustness benchmark.
highlights: Fish Audio ships upgraded Drama 3 weights
#1 open-weight on both Artificial Analysis Speech Arenas
Provider Voice: #6 overall, +38 Elo over Preview; Controlled Voice: +22 Elo
#1 of all models on Pronunciation Robustness
